sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Még means 'more' or 'another', and it goes right before the noun-t it modifies, the same position as kérek/szeretnék would go.

items.english: I'd like sugar and milk too.

sections.content: Kér még süteményt? asks if you'd like an additional pastry beyond what's already been ordered — még signals 'in addition to what we already talked about'.
